question: Can narrow schema and fidelity instruction fixes yield usable, bounded advisories without erasing supplied positive facts or inventing external certainty?
comparison: Fresh prospective verification only; not a causal comparison or statistical improvement estimate against Sprint 7.
public_contract: Original response fields, enum values, strict contradictory coverage rejection, graph/source/category identities, no_actions_executed and not_verified remain. Technical advisory may validly have zero findings; missing graph avoids generation.
acceptance: Returned schema-valid advisory for structurally sufficient SEC cases; exact identities/source membership; preserved stated facts and uncertainty; no fabricated authority or actions. Insufficient-information is reported separately, never inflated to usable advisory.
stopping: Exact model mismatch or unavailable => all NOT RUN
Retries/repairs consume the same global six-attempt cap; remaining cases NOT RUN
No automatic resume, optional cases, warm-up, replay, post-result tuning or extra live calls
novelty: Entirely new Maple DNS/approved archive, museum-caption/export and OCR-HTML/plain-text-translation scenarios. Old Cedar cases used only to diagnose general categories, not reused or edited as new inputs.
review: Deterministic checks separate from implementation-authored qualitative review; independent human adjudication pending.
